title: hax-network-bar
description: The top bar of every site in the HAX network: an icon for every property, your character, Merlin to jump anywhere, and Install HAX with every way to get it

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Which site this is: web, try, learn, elements, cloud or rpg (what it was called before, browser and docs, still works).

attributes.name: character
attributes.description: The character in the left corner, as an rpg-character code (RPG me makes one). Empty draws HAX's own.

attributes.name: install-method
attributes.description: The way to install whose tab is open; empty is the first

attributes.name: menu-open
attributes.description: The sites menu is open (narrow screens)

attributes.name: demo
attributes.description: The demo strip: a thin bar for a HAXcms demo with no backend (demo.hax.cloud). It says nothing is saved, links HAXcms in the browser and Install HAX, and has no Merlin of its own (the editor under it has him). It keeps --haxcms-top-offset on the page set to its height so the HAXcms editor bar sits under it.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: The bar for a full platform (HAXcms in the browser): shorter, with no character, Merlin or Future Traveler of its own, and the pre slot in the middle for the platform's own status and functions.

attributes.name: has-pre
attributes.description: the demo strip's pre slot holds something (a page's own controls)
